(1) the adversarial loss is an appropriate measure to detect violations of individual fairness; and (2) we develop a suite of tools to measure the adversarial loss, which can be used in practice to assess the fairness of ML models.

(1) the adversarial loss is a useful measure of the individual fairness of machine learning models and (2) the adversarial losses of machine learning models can be estimated and tested for statistical significance in a principled way using the tools that we developed in this research.

(1) we formalize the problem of detecting fairness violations in ML models as measuring the susceptibility to a form of adversarially-induced fairness violation and (2) we develop a suite of statistical inference tools for this problem.
